# Genesis Apocryphon Column 14 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 1QapGen (Cave 1), Col. 14 | **Condition:** Nearly destroyed; only scattered words survive

---

**14:1** [...] Ham [...] his-territory [...] of-the-land [...]

**14:2** [...] the-south [...] and-all the-land of [...] the-heat [...]

**14:3** [...] from [...] to-the-sea [...] the-great-sea [...]

**14:4** [...] and-westward [...] the-land of-Egypt [...]

**14:5** [...] and-all the-peoples [...] who-dwell in-the-south [...]

**14:6** [...] the-land of-Canaan [...] was-in his-portion [...]

**14:7** [...] and-the-islands of-the-sea [...] to-the-west [...]

**14:8** [...]

---

*EMET notes: Column 14 is nearly destroyed. Surviving fragments describe Ham's territorial allotment, encompassing the southern lands including Egypt and Canaan. The geographical scope parallels Jubilees 8:22-9:1. "The great sea" refers to the Mediterranean. Construct chains preserved with hyphens.*
